title: Emergence
hint: Let the birds follow each other.
idea: Each bird follows a few simple rules. Together they form a flock, without a leader.

title: Growth
hint: Make each lily pad grow another.
idea: When the number doubles again and again, it grows faster and faster. This is exponential growth.

title: First principles
hint: Make the boat big enough to float.
idea: A boat must push aside enough water to support its weight. Start with that fact, rather than copying another boat.

title: Evidence
idea: A test lets us check an idea. Without air resistance, heavy and light balls fall at the same rate.

title: Feedback
idea: A thermostat turns the heater on when the room is cold and off when it is warm. This is feedback.

title: Networks
hint: Tap a road to close or open it.
idea: A network is made of things and their connections. Extra roads give us other ways to get there.

title: Scarcity
hint: Share six blocks between the three projects.
idea: There are only six blocks. Using one here means you cannot use it somewhere else.

title: Trade-offs
idea: More bars make this model stronger, but also heavier. Getting more of one thing can cost us another.

title: Spread
hint: Touch a dot. Watch the change spread.
idea: A small change can spread through a connected group, one neighbour at a time.

title: Patterns
hint: Watch what happens to the little squares.
idea: Simple rules can create surprising patterns. In this model, each square changes according to its neighbours.
